title: Uniform square-root noise sensitivity bound
statement: There is a constant $C\geq0$ such that, for every natural number $k$, every natural number $n$, every Boolean function $f$ on $n$ coordinates that is a polynomial threshold of degree at most $k$, and every real noise parameter $\delta$ with $0<\delta\leq\tfrac12$, the noise sensitivity of $f$ at parameter $\delta$ is at most $Ck\sqrt{\delta}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a polynomial threshold of degree at most $k$
caveat: The upstream definitions of polynomial threshold and noise sensitivity are not included.
